title: The partner moves the deal to WhatsApp
scenario: A partner you know emails that their corporate messaging is down and asks to continue a sensitive deal over WhatsApp. A new number then sends revised payment instructions.

answers.A: Proceed because the initial email came from the partner’s real address and the outage could be genuine.
answers.B: Verify the channel switch and payment instructions through a known corporate contact before acting.
answers.C: Keep the deal paused until the partner’s normal systems or approved communication route are restored.

explanation: A compromised mailbox can redirect a conversation to an attacker-controlled channel, where later instructions look continuous.
proTip: Channel switching can be the attack, not a convenience.
